name: smtp-utf8-rfc822-mailbox-permit-strict-9549-same-domain-valid
description: Strict-RFC-9549 reading: a mailbox-form rfc822 constraint (alice@example.com) applied to a SmtpUTF8Mailbox SAN is compared on the DOMAIN ONLY. The local part of the constraint is ignored, so a SAN at a different local part on the same domain (bob@example.com) satisfies the permit.
notes: Botan's matcher does NOT implement the strict-RFC-9549 reading: it treats mailbox-form rfc822 constraints as not applying to SmtpUTF8Mailbox SANs at all, so it rejects this leaf as not-permitted.
